brief.audience: Engineering and product leaders approving production readiness
brief.prompt: Create a seven-scene decision story for engineering and product leaders about crossing from plausible AI output to reliable production slide creation. Use one threshold-line motif that visibly progresses across every scene; a guarded-threshold metaphor that transforms from exposure to controlled passage; reveal pacing that orients, creates tension, hints, reveals, proves, climaxes, then resolves; an emotional arc that rises to the production gate and releases into owned action; and at least four clearly distinct compositions. Include an inspectable risk chart and an editable system-flow diagram. End with one accountable decision.
brief.purpose: Prove NodeSlide agents finish coherent, editable, published decks
successCriteria: The threshold metaphor transforms across slides
At least four compositions are visibly distinct
PPTX and public share both complete

elements.content: Every leader here has watched an AI generate a deck that looked right — until someone tried to edit, export, or defend it.
